subject: general
question: How many central universities have been selected to implement the Dr. Ambedkar Centre of Excellence (DACE) scheme launched on 22 April 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**31 central universities**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **31 central universities** have been selected to implement the Dr. Ambedkar Centre of Excellence (DACE) scheme.
 
• The scheme was launched on **22 April 2022** with the aim of providing specialized coaching for Scheduled Caste students to help them succeed in competitive examinations.
 
• The DACE scheme is part of the government's efforts to promote educational opportunities and social inclusion for marginalized communities.
 
• Each selected central university will establish a Dr. Ambedkar Centre of Excellence to provide coaching and support to the students.
 
• This initiative reflects the government's commitment to enhancing the educational prospects and career opportunities for Scheduled Caste students.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The DACE scheme is named after Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, a key architect of the Indian Constitution and a champion of social justice and equality.
 
• Dr. Ambedkar's vision of an inclusive society is reflected in the objectives of the DACE scheme, which seeks to empower and uplift students from Scheduled Caste communities.
 
• The scheme will provide resources such as study materials, coaching classes, and mentorship to help students prepare for competitive exams.
 
• The implementation of the DACE scheme is expected to have a significant impact on the educational and professional outcomes of Scheduled Caste students across India.
